requirements.text: .html and .htm files under configured document paths appear in Documents View.
Root index.html does not appear in Documents View when project.document.paths includes ./
CSS, JavaScript, image, and font assets used by HTML are servable via the raw-preview route but do not appear as selectable Documents View files.
Existing .md discovery, selection, markdown rendering, tabs, favorites, and timestamps continue to work unchanged.
Selecting an HTML file renders an iframe preview instead of the markdown renderer.
Selecting an HTML file first mints an owner-only internal preview token before the iframe loads.
HTML iframe src uses /api/documents/raw-preview/:token/*documentPath and relative subresources resolve under the same preview-token path prefix.
HTML files that reference relative CSS, JavaScript, and image assets load those assets when they remain inside the token-scoped directory and configured document paths.
External edits to a selected .html or .htm file refresh the HTML preview through the document-change SSE path.
Unknown file kinds render a non-preview state and do not call the markdown renderer.
documentFilenameTabModel remains markdown-only; HTML sibling tabs are out of scope.
Raw preview requests for files outside configured document paths return 403.
Raw requests using .., absolute paths, encoded traversal, or project-root escapes return 403.
Raw requests for unknown projects return 404.
Raw preview requests without a valid unexpired preview token do not disclose file contents.
Read-token and shared-session users cannot mint HTML preview tokens in v1.
HtmlSandboxViewer iframe uses sandbox without allow-same-origin.
Preview-token minting stays behind owner-authenticated /api middleware.
The raw-preview handler rejects missing, expired, malformed, or tampered preview tokens before file resolution.
Preview tokens expire within 5 minutes or less.
Preview tokens are scoped to one project and one selected HTML document directory.
Preview tokens cannot be used to read sibling files outside the token-scoped document directory.
Raw preview route sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
Previewed HTML cannot read parent window, parent DOM, or parent local storage in browser coverage.
Previewed HTML cannot perform owner-only mutation without the existing owner-intent protections.
Previewed HTML cannot fetch('/api/*') because connect-src 'none' blocks script network access.
The normal API auth exemption in apiAuth.ts adds only a GET exemption for /api/documents/raw-preview/*; no broad exemption.
Raw serving is binary-safe and does not use UTF-8 string reads for non-markdown assets.
MIME handling uses a small local map covering .html .htm .css .js .mjs .json .png .jpg .jpeg .gif .webp .svg .ico .woff .woff2, or rejects unsupported types explicitly; no new dependency.
Large raw files are streamed or otherwise handled without loading unnecessary duplicate string copies.
The implementation introduces no new runtime package.
Raw preview request with expired token is rejected before file resolution.
Raw preview request with tampered token signature is rejected before file resolution.
Raw preview request with token scoped to project A used to request a path in project B is rejected.
Raw preview request with token scoped to directory D used to request a sibling file outside D is rejected.
URL-encoded path traversal payload (e.g. %2e%2e) in raw preview path is rejected with 403.
iframe with allow-same-origin token present fails the unit test (token must never appear).
Query-param preview URL for iframe HTML preview is not used (token must be in path prefix).
Root index.html is excluded from discovery even when ./ is in document paths.
ENOENT on a raw preview subresource returns 404 without leaking filesystem absolute paths.

Raw-preview responses set X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (overriding the global DENY set by securityHeaders middleware in originPolicy.ts:103-107, mounted globally at server.ts:150) so the sandboxed iframe can load; all other routes keep DENY.

The HTML preview iframe fills the documents-view preview panel (full width and height below the app header), matching the markdown viewer's panel-filling behavior. The iframe must not collapse to its intrinsic 300x150 default.

Raw HTML responses set a CSP that is STRICT by default (sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'). The non-negotiable directives (connect-src 'none', img-src 'self' data:, default-src 'none', no allow-same-origin, base-uri/form-action 'none') hold in EVERY configuration. External origins and unsafe-eval are added ONLY when the project opts in via [project.document.preview] config (C-2.23, C-2.24).

A per-project config field [project.document.preview].allowedExternalDomains (array of hostnames, default empty) controls which external script/style/font origins the preview CSP allows. Default empty means no external origins — strict. Each entry is a conscious owner decision.

A per-project config field [project.document.preview].allowUnsafeEval (boolean, default false) controls whether 'unsafe-eval' is added to script-src. Default false. Required for eval-based frameworks (Alpine.js, Tailwind CDN JIT); the owner opts in consciously.

When a selected HTML file references external origins or capabilities (eval) not yet allowed by the project's preview config, the user is told which domains/capabilities need attention (via the mint response or a dialog), so the opt-in is conscious rather than implicit.

scenarios.title: html and htm files appear in document tree
scenarios.given: Given a configured document path contains index.html and report.htm
scenarios.when: When the documents tree is loaded
scenarios.then: Then both files appear as selectable HTML-kind nodes

scenarios.title: markdown discovery unaffected by html support
scenarios.given: Given the repo has .md and .html files in a document path
scenarios.when: When the documents tree is loaded
scenarios.then: Then .md files render via MarkdownViewer exactly as before and .html files render via HtmlSandboxViewer

scenarios.title: html selection shows iframe not markdown
scenarios.given: Given an HTML-kind file is visible in the tree
scenarios.then: Then an HtmlSandboxViewer iframe is rendered instead of the markdown viewer

scenarios.title: owner preview token minted before iframe src
scenarios.given: Given an owner-authenticated user selects an HTML file
scenarios.then: Then the client first POSTs to /api/documents/preview-token and only sets the iframe src after receiving a token

scenarios.title: iframe src uses path-style token URL
scenarios.given: Given an HTML file is selected and a preview token minted
scenarios.when: When the iframe src is constructed
scenarios.then: Then the src is /api/documents/raw-preview/:token/*documentPath with the token in the path prefix

scenarios.title: relative subresources resolve via token prefix
scenarios.given: Given an HTML file references relative style.css and app.js
scenarios.then: Then the browser resolves those URLs to /api/documents/raw-preview/:token/<sibling> and they are served when inside the token-scoped directory

scenarios.title: html external edit triggers refresh
scenarios.given: Given an HTML preview is open and the file is edited on disk
scenarios.when: When the file watcher emits a document-change event for .html
scenarios.then: Then the iframe reloads with the updated content

scenarios.title: unknown file kind renders non-preview state
scenarios.given: Given a file with a kind that is neither markdown nor html
scenarios.then: Then a non-preview placeholder is rendered and MarkdownViewer is not called

scenarios.title: filename tab grouping remains markdown only
scenarios.when: When the filename tab model runs
scenarios.then: Then no html sibling tabs are produced (model stays markdown-only)

scenarios.title: assets servable but not visible
scenarios.given: Given a document directory contains style.css app.js image.png alongside index.html
scenarios.when: When the documents tree is rendered
scenarios.then: Then only the .html files appear; the css/js/png are servable via raw-preview but absent from the tree

scenarios.title: root app shell not previewable
scenarios.given: Given project.document.paths includes ./ and the repo root has index.html
scenarios.then: Then the root index.html does not appear as a document node

scenarios.title: HTML preview iframe fills the panel
scenarios.given: Given an HTML file is selected and the iframe is rendered
scenarios.when: When the documents-view preview panel is measured
scenarios.then: Then the iframe bounding box equals the preview panel bounding box (full width and height)

scenarios.title: Unconfigured external domains are surfaced to the user
scenarios.given: Given a project with empty allowedExternalDomains and an HTML file referencing cdn.tailwindcss.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net
scenarios.when: When the user selects the HTML file and the mint endpoint scans its external references
scenarios.then: Then the user is shown the list of domains needing approval (cdn.tailwindcss.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net) and can opt in per-domain
